# S77 — A queued run whose project was removed does not start

S05 (landed 67521b0) admits a queued run in startQueuedLocked (internal/daemon/runs.go:352-387) using hasRoomLocked (:326-350). When the run's project is no longer in the registry, hasRoomLocked finds no project (find, handlers.go:135) and applies no project cap, so the run starts. Noted in the S05 run report.

**Findings:**  · **Size:** S `[needs-owner]` · **Tree:**

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

A run of a project that is no longer registered starts with no per-project cap and with a runDeps and project that the registry no longer describes.

- internal/daemon/runs.go: startQueuedLocked and hasRoomLocked.
- internal/daemon/runs_test.go: a test beside the S05 wave tests.
